verdict.rationale: Firstbase documents a compliance dashboard that gives a per-state overview where users click a state to see requirements and upcoming deadlines and take action, which covers the 'see upcoming filing deadlines' half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows reminders or notifications before each deadline; the 'forget the stress of staying compliant' line is marketing, not a reminder feature. missing for 10: documented deadline reminders or alerts before each filing, a consolidated calendar view across all deadlines rather than per-state drill-down, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboard.
